name: Luca
source:
Rhea's oldest childhood friend. He is looked up to as a big brother figure. He's calm, thoughtful, and dependable in a crisis, and has a wealth of general knowledge. He joined the army one year ago, and returns a markedly different man. Just what did he do on the battlefield, and what did he see?


(Taken from [url=https://sekaiproject.com/products/this-world-unknown/]website[/url])
